description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Nodal Exchange is a derivatives exchange providing price, credit, and liquidity risk management in the North American commodities markets. The Software Engineer will review requirements, design and develop distributed software systems, create automated tests, and demonstrate solutions to stakeholders across the organization.
Software engineer building distributed systems, clarifying requirements, and developing automated tests

Responsibilities:
• Review requirements for completeness and clarity, working with stakeholders to finalize them
• Design, develop, test, maintain and improve distributed and parallel software systems
• Develop automated test scripts to ensure high quality software
• Provide demonstrations to individuals throughout the organization

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or related technical field
• Strong programming skills in one or more of the following programming languages: Java, Kotlin, Javascript
• Knowledge/experience with SpringBoot, Docker, ReactJs
• Comfortable with modern web technologies and front-end frameworks such as React
• Knowledge/experience with relational databases, NoSQL databases, GitHub
• Solid understanding of Object Oriented Design concepts
• Strong quantitative skills
• Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical colleagues
• Love of coding, automation, and learning new technologies
• Confidence in own ideas along with openness to others' ideas
• Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis

Preferred:
• Experience with identity and access management (IAM) standards (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML) and integrating with modern Identity Providers is a plus
